 Mount Sharp is composed of sedimentary rocks that are over a billion years old . The rocks include conglomerates , sandstones , mudstones , and siltstones . They are believed to have formed from the erosion of older rock deposits and from material transported downstream into lakes and rivers . These rocks were originally deposited in layers within a basin , but have been thrust up and folded by tectonic forces . The mountain is composed of six geologic units , or layers , from oldest to youngest , called the Sheepbed , Shara , Stimson , Merrion , Kennecott , and Aeolian units . These units differ from one another in texture and in the presence or absence of fossils .

As a result , the first South Asian immigrants to the UK were not entitled to the same rights as other British citizens , and they were subject to discrimination as a result .

 The wing feathers of a typical parrot are broad and tapered , with the vanes being broad with a narrower leading edge and a thicker trailing edge . This provides the bird with a large wing area , increasing the amount of lift generated while soaring in thermals . The taper causes airflow over the wing to be less turbulent , reducing drag while flying and landing . The trailing edge is also strengthened with stiffening bars , while the primary feathers on the leading edge of the wing are more numerous , and the tips of the feathers are notched to further stiffen the leading edge of the wing . The feathers are flattened from front to back with a smooth surface , and the feathers from the shoulder are longer than those toward the wingtip to increase lift . Once a fish is caught it is cleaned and the head , viscera , and scales are removed before the fish is pounded into a paste . The paste is then mixed with wheat flour , salt , and spices such as garlic and turmeric . The paste is then formed into balls and dried in the sun .  Divers are very common predators of the sand shark . They attack the shark by striking the snout , severing the spinal column . The sand shark is a prey species of two diving bird species : the brown pelican ( Pelecanus occidentalis ) and the least tern ( Sternula antillarum ) . The dolphin bites through the pectoral fins of the shark , leaving the wound open to air which then allows the dolphin to grip the animal and drag it underwater . Dolphins are known to eat most , if not all , of the sand shark , including the internal organs , cartilage and fins .

Sustainable building is a way to reduce the environmental impact of a structure 's construction , operation , maintenance , and demolition . A building can be designed and operated in a way that meets the needs of its occupants and users while also achieving environmental and economic goals .

Environmental performance refers to the reduction of environmental impacts , such as the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions and water use .

The kingdom was centered on the area around Meroe , and other prominent cities were Qasr Ibrim , Musawwarat es @-@ Sufra , and Gebel Barkal . The Meroitic capital was moved from Napata to Meroe during the first half of the 3rd century BCE , after the Egyptian Ptolemaic dynasty 's conquest of the southern part of the Nile Valley . The last major kingdom to rule the Nile Valley was that of the Kushites , an ancient African people in what is now known as Sudan . The Kushite Kingdom was the successor to the New Kingdom of Egypt , which collapsed in 1075 BCE .

Cannonballs were originally fitted into a cradle called a carriage , and the gun was mounted in a pit . The cradle was placed on top of the pit and the gun was aimed by moving the pit . The cannonball was placed in the muzzle , and the gun was loaded and aimed by a crew of two or three , who were under the gun and thus exposed to enemy fire . The gun was loaded by ramming the ball into the barrel with a wooden mallet . The cannonball was rammed against the chamber at the rear of the barrel . A metal spike called a tang ( or tog ) was placed into a hole in the rear of the cannonball . The cannon was then primed by pouring gunpowder into the tang . The rammer would then pull the lanyard which would set off the primer and fire the gun . After firing the cannon would be unloaded and recoil back into the pit . When the gun was elevated the pit would be deeper , lowering the muzzle , and lowering the gun would cause it to recoil and elevate . The gun was fired at the highest angle that was safe for the gunpowder used .

A symbol can be a physical entity such as a gesture , object , drawing or sound , or it may be abstract such as a story or a mathematical expression . Languages allow a community to transmit and store information about the world and their experience in it . Linguists classify symbols into categories : phonemes ( the smallest distinctive sound elements of a language ) , lexemes ( the smallest semantically distinguishable units of lexical meaning , or words ) , and morphemes ( the smallest meaningful units of a language ) . 


 The smallest meaningful units are called morphemes . Morphemes do not have to be individual words but can be the individual root words of a compound word or the prefixes and suffixes that form a word . A morpheme is the smallest semantically meaningful unit of language , so that a single morpheme may be an individual word , but a word may also contain more than one morpheme .  The closest star to the Sun ( and the rest of the Solar System ) is Proxima Centauri . Although that star is approximately 4 @.@ 2 light @-@ years away , the Sun is still being tidally locked to it , because of the close proximity . This means that on a tidal locking timescale , which is 32 million years , the Sun will eventually become a giant . 


 The tides on the Earth would increase about 1000 times in the next 60 billion years . This would cause the Earth 's rotation to slow and eventually stop , but the Moon 's tidal bulge would remain . The Moon 's orbital decay would cause it to crash into the Earth 's tidal bulge , causing the Earth to become tidally locked to the Moon . The time until the Moon 's collision with Earth is estimated to be about 50 billion years .

The Chinese lunisolar calendar is also known as the Chinese calendar , traditional Chinese calendar , or Far Eastern calendar . It is not an exact system of measuring time : for example , a " year " begins with the second new moon after the winter solstice and may contain 12 or 13 lunar months depending on the year . The system was created by combining the cycles of the moon and the sun . The resultant calendar was then adjusted periodically by intercalating one or two extra months to keep it in step with the solar year . The months and days of the calendar were named after astronomical and agricultural features . The calendar is now being replaced in mainland China by the Gregorian calendar .

 The aerodynamic forces on a bird in flight are drag ( retarding force ) and lift ( supporting force ) . Wing design and feather shape provide the aerodynamic forces necessary to propel and support the body of a flying bird . Wings are designed to be as long as possible in order to generate the maximum amount of lift and as thin as possible to minimize drag . A wing that is too thick produces too much drag and one that is too thin generates too little lift , thereby increasing the bird 's stall speed . 


 Flapping flight requires a large aerodynamic force . Birds have to provide this force , in order to lift themselves into the air . The flapping motion of a bird 's wings requires a high power output , but the energy cost is low as birds use the potential energy of the air to gain height during climbing , which reduces the work necessary to overcome gravity .  During the Warring States period , Chinese military thought underwent a fundamental change with the rise of the philosophical tradition of Legalism . The Legalist school of thought asserted that a person 's innate morality was not necessarily good , and so society 's morality was subject to the state 's control . Morality was not based on natural law , but was instead based on the laws imposed by rulers . This was most fully developed in the work of Han Fei and his student Li Si , who believed that the state was essentially a machine and that the government of this machine could be described in mathematical terms . They argued that the military was a key component of the state , and that without military power , the state would be unable to enforce the laws which protected the interests of its rulers . This change in the state 's perception of the military was reflected in the growth of the central government 's military budget , which was often used to reward military personnel . During this period , the military became an important political institution , and the top military commanders were often rewarded with political positions within the government .

 The early Church developed a strong ascetic tradition , which was particularly evident during the monastic movement , which became prominent during the 4th century . In his Letter to Malchus , Athanasius of Alexandria recommended abstention from marriage , which he argued was essential to perfection in the Christian life . Basil of Caesarea argued that all sexual activity was sinful . In his Rules for Beggars , the Cappadocian father Gregory of Nyssa , in 380 , advised that married persons should abstain from sexual activity for one day in every seven . By the 5th century , there were strong arguments for chastity from within the Church . 


 The monastic movement of the 4th and 5th centuries led to an increasing debate on the value of marriage . John Chrysostom , bishop of Constantinople , delivered a series of sermons between 386 and 388 , advocating asceticism and attacking the institution of marriage , and in particular remarriage after the death of a spouse .

Thirdly , it is not possible to use one @-@ time pad encryption to transmit messages containing errors and bit stuffing patterns . Finally , the fact that a number of other protocols already existed and were being used in the early Internet days , which were based on hash functions , made it unnecessary to implement one @-@ time pad encryption protocols . R. W. E. Moore ( 1929 ) is a foundational work in the history of ideas . Moore 's study is a pioneering work of intellectual history in many ways . It was one of the first intellectual histories written in English , and the first to systematically use modern scientific methods in the history of ideas . While Moore used the tools of modern philosophy , he employed them to describe the historical development of ideas . Moore 's book is the first systematic survey of the " British empiricist " school , and the first to trace the development of empiricism as an historical movement . In writing his history , Moore used what he called the " internal method " of intellectual history . The internal method is a historical method in which the historian of ideas focuses on the ideas of the individual philosophers themselves , rather than focusing on broader questions of context or influence . While Moore 's internal method was initially controversial , it is now commonly employed by historians of ideas and the history of science .

 listade = The Ajanta Caves are a series of 30 Buddhist caves situated in Aurangabad District in Maharashtra state of India . The Ajanta Caves , dating from the 2nd century BCE to about 480 CE , include paintings and rock cut sculptures described as among the finest surviving examples of ancient Indian art , particularly expressions of the Mahayana school of Buddhism . They were built in two periods : the first was between the 2nd century BCE and the 1st century CE ; the second period started around 460 CE and lasted about 200 years . The caves , cut into the side of a rocky hill , are separated into two groups separated by a natural gap. Today , the caves form a UNESCO World Heritage Site and attract 75 % of the 1.3 million annual visitors to the state of Maharashtra . 


 The caves , 31 in total , represent a religious complex of the Buddhist Hinayana ( or Theravada ) school dating from the 2nd century BCE to about 480 CE

The town is now part of the civil parish of Aylsham with Foxley , which was created in 1934 by the merger of the parish of Aylsham with the parish of Foxley , although the two parishes are still separate ecclesiastical parishes .
